abstract: The pregnancy outcome of 57 women who had been treated for trophoblastic disease, between 1975 and 1982, was studied. All patients had regular menstrual cycle within six months after the last chemotherapy. Frequency of secondary infertility is 5% (3/60). No correlation between the amount of chemotherapy and secondary infertility was apparent. Of eighty-three pregnancies in 57 women, 55 pregnancies or 66.3% terminated in full term deliveries, 4 or 4.8% terminated in premature deliveries. Eleven of the 83 or 11.3% ended in spontaneous abortions and 2 or 2.4% in recurrent hydatiditorm mole. Only one infant (1.7%) had congenital malformation. There was no increase in fetal wastage or congenital anomaly when compared with pregnancies prior to chemotherapy or after untreated molar patients. Among the 59 live born infants, 4 or 6.8% infants belong to light for date, 49 or 83.1% to appropriate for date and 6 or 10.2% to heavy for date. Chemotherapic agents, mainly MTX and Act-D, appeared to have no effect on fetal growth. The incidence of choriocarcinoma subsequent to pregnancy in treated patients was 1.8% (1/57) and was 0.6% (2/365) in untreated molar patients (n.s.).
abstract_ja: 1975年から1982年の間に妊娠性絨毛性疾患で治療を受けた57例の女性の妊娠転帰を検討した。全例で化学療法後6か月以内に規則的な月経周期が認められた。続発性不妊症の頻度は5%(3/60)であった。化学療法の量と続発性不妊症の間に相関は認められなかった。57例の女性の83回の妊娠のうち、55回(66.3%)は正期産、4回(4.8%)は早産で終了した。83回のうち11回(11.3%)は自然流産、2回(2.4%)は反復性胞状奇胎で終了した。出生児1人(1.7%)に先天奇形が認められた。化学療法前の妊娠、または未治療の奇胎患者後の妊娠と比較して、胎児喪失や先天異常の増加は認められなかった。出生児59人のうち、4人(6.8%)は在胎日数より小さく、49人(83.1%)は適切な在胎日数、6人(10.2%)は在胎日数より大きかった。主にメトトレキサート(MTX)とアクチノマイシンD(ACT-D)の化学療法薬は胎児発育に影響しないと考えられた。治療患者における妊娠後の絨毛癌の発生率は1.8%(1/57)で、未治療の奇胎患者では0.6%(2/365)であった(有意差なし)。
